items.t: Introduced the ICE Breaker Act of 2026, a bill that would bar ICE agents hired under President Donald Trump from working as police officers in Maryland (2026).
items.q: The legislation, which is called the “ICE Breaker Act of 2026” is sponsored by Maryland State Del. Adrian Boafo (D). Under the proposed legislation, ICE agents hired under President Donald Trump’s presidency would be barred from working as police officers
